summary: Verified the CLI-managed Claude adapter, retired plugin packaging, documentation, and Forge/Work compatibility against the workspace build and disposable homes.

validations.note: Covered seven projected Claude skills, repeat install/sync/uninstall, collisions, symlinks, and preservation of unrelated user state.
Verified package contents omit retired Claude plugin, provider wrappers, and hooks.
The complete suite passed on the final source tree, including Forge and Work regressions.
Version remains 5.1.0; required runtime assets are present and retired plugin paths are absent.

notes: These are workspace and disposable-filesystem checks, not a real Claude Code host UI discovery test or independent QA. No version bump, release, global installation, commit, or push occurred. Existing user-installed Claude plugins were not modified. This evidence is maker-reported; the task review is not independent certification.
